plugins.name: Advanced Cutting
plugins.summary: Cuts a finished video into pieces: by size (each under so many GB), by chapters (so many in each) or by length (so many hours), each starting where a chapter starts, with its own subtitles and YouTube chapter list. Nothing is encoded again. From the Video tab, or each time a project's video is made.

plugins.name: Branding
plugins.summary: Your channel's logo in a corner of every video, and an intro and an outro (a clip or a picture) before and after each part. Set once in Settings; each project can leave either out.

plugins.name: EPUB comics
plugins.summary: Chapters imported from a comic's .epub (DRM-free), as from a .cbz: a volume is split into its chapters by its table of contents, leaving out its contents, copyright, advertisement and divider pages.

plugins.name: Find the series
plugins.summary: Search for a series instead of typing its name: names the project, suggests its kind and fills in its characters, with their pictures, from AniList or your other sources. A series picked from a source of yours with chapters gets them too, and its characters from AniList.

plugins.name: New chapters on a schedule
plugins.summary: Checks your projects' series for new chapters on the days and at the time you choose, through the sources you added yourself, and gets them, and if you like recaps them.

plugins.name: Overnight queue
plugins.summary: Line up several projects and Make the recap runs them one after another, from a time you choose until a time you choose. A project that stops to ask you something is left for the morning.

plugins.name: Reading Spanish comics
plugins.summary: Comics in Spanish, read in Spanish and translated into English by your script writer, as Korean, Chinese and Japanese ones are. Downloads PaddleOCR's reader for Latin-alphabet text the first time (about 13 MB).

plugins.name: Recaps in Spanish
plugins.summary: A project's recap narrated in Spanish (Latin America or Spain): the script, the voice, the subtitles, the captions and the suggested YouTube title, whatever language the comic is in.

plugins.name: Site check
plugins.summary: When a site answers your sources with Cloudflare's check for a person, pass it yourself in a small window: Recap Studio then gets that site's chapters with your pass until it runs out. Needs Recap Studio 0.2.4.

plugins.name: Trending finder
plugins.summary: The series trending now on AniList and looked at most on MangaUpdates, by kind (manga, manhwa, manhua), genre and status, with the ones you have a project of marked. Make a project of one straight from the list, and its chapters are looked for in your own sources.

plugins.name: Watched folder
plugins.summary: Drop chapters (folders of pictures, .zip or .cbz) into a folder named after their project, and they're added to it and, if you like, recapped.

plugins.name: When a video is done
plugins.summary: When a project's video is made: copies it (and its subtitles, thumbnail and Shorts) to a folder, runs a command of yours, and tells your phone through ntfy or a Discord or Slack webhook. It can also tell you when a recap stops to ask you something or fails.

plugins.name: Post to YouTube
plugins.summary: Posts a project's video to your YouTube channel, with its title, chapters and thumbnail, and its Shorts all at once or one a day: when the video is made, or when you say. Adds a step to New project.

plugins.name: AniList
plugins.summary: Series details and characters for Recap Studio, from AniList's public API (no account or key needed).

plugins.name: Kitsu
plugins.summary: Series details and characters for Recap Studio, from Kitsu's public API (no account or key needed).

plugins.name: MangaUpdates
plugins.summary: Series details for Recap Studio, from MangaUpdates' public API (no account or key needed).
